candidates: When documenting or writing `yarn task` commands in this repository (instructions, READMEs, AI-assistant guidance, etc.), always include the `--start-from` flag (e.g., `--start-from auto`). Omitting it causes the task CLI to enter interactive mode and block, making the command unusable in non-interactive contexts such as CI or agent sessions.

When documenting build, compile, or test commands, prefer `yarn task` as the primary documented form (the project's custom task-runner wrapper) rather than replacing it with equivalent raw `yarn nx` commands. If NX equivalents are shown, present them as alternatives alongside the `yarn task` form so readers are not confused about which interface is canonical.

In markdown files, bare URLs (e.g. `http://localhost:6006/`) must be wrapped in markdown link syntax (`[http://localhost:6006/](http://localhost:6006/)`) or enclosed in backtick code formatting. Bare URLs trigger markdownlint rule MD034 (no-bare-urls), which is enforced in this project's linting pipeline.
